description: Investigates whether the 51 existing Rust hecke-engine certificates need a converter to canonical tr_M for use in the categorical mass formula.  CONCLUSION: bridge is unnecessary.  Pyhecke's markov_trace_symbolic_eval scales linearly via the V_s transfer-matrix recursion and computes canonical tr_M for ²⁰⁸Pb (n=624) in ~40 ms.  The Rust engine's polynomial-basis enumeration is the wrong algorithm for this task; its f_pauli output is a structurally distinct Wedderburn PSD diagnostic, useful for other purposes.
rationale: pyhecke.markov_trace_symbolic_eval is O(n) via V_s recursion
Rust v9 has compute_tr_markov_f64 (same formula) but doesn't store it
Rust v11_modular doesn't compute tr_M at all (only f_pauli/tr_alt/net)
Rust f_pauli is a different operator (Pauli-accumulator quotient)
Bottleneck for Z > 10 is content (which braids), not compute
